response.sql: WITH total_races AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM races), circuit_stats AS (SELECT r.circuitId, AVG(r.round) as avg_round, COUNT(*) as num_races FROM races r GROUP BY r.circuitId) SELECT cs.circuitId, cs.avg_round, cs.num_races, CAST(cs.num_races AS FLOAT) / tr.total as share FROM circuit_stats cs, total_races tr ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
